violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Working container holding food item was not labeled properly to identify contents. Several meat items stored in refrigerator without proper labeling
Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food. Food items stored with eggs in the egg container.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. Meat, vegetables, etc. stored without proper labeling.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room was not provided with a tight fitting or self closing door.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Single-use items were found stored on the floor of the storage area. Single-use items should be stored off of the floor.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Carpeting was installed as floor covering where not allowed. Storage area has carpeting on the floor. Carpet should not be installed in storage areas.
